records.name: Vue UDialog
records.purpose: Controlled modal dialog with header, footer, close button, Escape and mask dismissal, optional scroll lock, z-index stacking, enter and leave motion hooks and focus restore, rendered into a portal.
records.surface: UDialog is an Options API component (the only family component with a setup() function, used for useId) rendered through UPortal with the appendTo prop forwarded to it. Barrel exports: UDialog and createBaseDialog; dialogStyleModule and DialogClassesParams are exported from dialog-style.ts but not re-exported. componentName dialog; Aura registry key dialog. Declared emits: update:visible, show, hide and after-hide, declared at Dialog.vue line 117 and emitted at lines 189 (show), 211 (hide) and 220 (after-hide); close() only emits update:visible false, so visibility is controlled by the parent. Props and defaults: visible = false, header = null, footer = null, modal = true, closable = true, closeOnEscape = true, dismissableMask = false, blockScroll = false, baseZIndex = 0, autoZIndex = true, role = "dialog", position = "center", appendTo = "body", ariaCloseLabel = "Close". There is no draggable or maximizable support (no draggable or maximizable) in the component. The focus trap directive is disabled when modal is false; scroll lock is registered on enter and unregistered on after-leave and unmount when modal or blockScroll is set. The z-index entry (Z_INDEX_KEYS.modal) is set on enter when autoZIndex and cleared on after-leave and on unmount. Escape is registered through createGlobalEscapeKeyMixin with the DIALOG priority and a display-order mixin (group dialog) shares the Escape registry with drawer, popover and confirm-popup. Mask dismissal needs dismissableMask and modal and requires mouse-down and the event target to be the mask. aria-labelledby is set only when header is truthy (the title span receives the id ${dialogId}_header built from useId). Focus search order footer, header, content, then the close button on after-enter; focus returns to the previously focused element on leave. onBeforeLeave is an empty handler. The footer renders when the footer prop or the footer slot is present. The metadata record packages/component-metadata/src/records/dialog.ts cites lines 118, 177, 199 and 208 of Dialog.vue, which differ from the current lines 117, 189, 211 and 220 (the record cites lines 118, 177, 199 and 208); its event facts list update:visible, show and hide and omit after-hide, although the source declares and emits after-hide. dialog-style.ts is a typed StyleModule that combines the uix-styles dialog stylesheet with a local mask rule; the class u-overlay-mask (applied when modal) and u-dialog-close-button have no CSS rule in either stylesheet. dialog.api.mdx is a generated API page and is excluded as supporting documentation. Foundation imports: vue-core base, overlay, escape, focus-trap, zindex, scroll-lock, motion and icons; uix-utils escape and dom; uix-styles dialog; ripple.

records.name: Vue UDrawer
records.purpose: Controlled edge-anchored panel with header, close button, Escape and mask dismissal and a focus trap, rendered into a portal without leave motion.
records.surface: UDrawer is an Options API component rendered through UPortal with the appendTo prop forwarded to it. Barrel exports: UDrawer and createBaseDrawer; drawerStyleModule and DrawerClassesParams are exported from drawer-style.ts but not re-exported. componentName drawer; Aura registry key drawer. Declared emits: update:visible, show and hide; show and hide are emitted only by the visible watcher, so mount with visible true does not emit show. Props and defaults: visible = false, header = null, position = "left", modal = true, dismissible = true, closable = true, closeOnEscape = true, appendTo = "body", ariaCloseLabel = "Close". modal is read only by the mask-click dismissal condition: the mask is always rendered and the focus trap is always enabled whatever modal is. Escape reaches close() through two paths: the global Escape mixin (SIDEBAR priority, display-order group sidebar, sharing the Escape registry) and a root keydown handler that checks event.code. The root has role complementary and no aria-labelledby or id on the title; the footer renders only for the footer slot (there is no footer prop). There is no scroll lock, no motion hook and no leave transition: hiding removes the mask immediately. The ZIndex entry is not reverted on hide: z-index is set (Z_INDEX_KEYS.modal) after show and cleared only on unmount, when the mask ref is still present. drawer-style.ts is an untyped style module; u-drawer-close-button has no CSS rule. records.name: Vue v-tooltip directive
records.purpose: Directive that shows a body-appended tooltip panel for the host element on hover or focus with optional delays, HTML content and auto-hide control.
records.surface: v-tooltip is a directive (no component, no Base factory, no plugin install): tooltipDirective is created with createDirective and has mounted, updated and unmounted hooks; users register it with app.directive or a local directives option. Barrel exports: tooltipDirective and type TooltipBindingValue; tooltipStyleModule is exported from tooltip-style.ts but not re-exported. Aura registry key tooltip. The binding is a string shorthand or an object with value, disabled, escape, class, fitContent, id, showDelay, hideDelay and autoHide; defaults: escape = true, showDelay = 0, hideDelay = 0, autoHide = true, id from uuid("u_tooltip"), fitContent applied unless false. Listeners mouseenter, mouseleave, focus and blur are attached with addEventListener on the host and removed on unbind. updated unbinds and rebinds, which removes an open panel. onEnter does not clear showTimer (it clears only hideTimer) and showTooltip does not check for an existing panel, so repeated entries can append duplicate panels. autoHide false leaves the panel until unbind. escape false assigns innerHTML; otherwise textContent is used. The panel is appended to document.body with role tooltip and an aria-describedby token on the host, positioned from the host rect plus scroll offsets plus 4, with Z_INDEX_KEYS.tooltip set and cleared on hide. No resize or scroll handling and no Escape handling. The directive never reads tooltipStyleModule.classes: u-tooltip-arrow and the position classes are never applied (only u-tooltip, the custom class and u-tooltip-text). The metadata record packages/component-metadata/src/records/tooltip.ts cites tooltip.ts:150-161 for the hooks, whereas the hooks block starts at line 167; its Vue events: [] matches the absence of emits in a directive. tooltip-style.ts is a typed StyleModule over the uix-styles tooltip stylesheet.

records.name: Vue UBlockUI
records.purpose: Wrapper that overlays its content with a blocking mask, optionally fixed to the document with scroll lock and z-index stacking.
records.surface: UBlockUI is an Options API component with inheritAttrs false with no $attrs binding. Barrel exports: UBlockUI and createBaseBlockUI; blockUiStyleModule and BlockUIMaskParams are exported from block-ui-style.ts but not re-exported. componentName blockui differs from the family directory block-ui; Aura registry key blockui. Declared emits: blocked and unblocked. Props and defaults: blocked = false, fullScreen = false, baseZIndex = 0, autoZIndex = true. A module-level counter instanceCount builds the scroll lock id per instance. blocked at mount runs block() and emits blocked; the blocked watcher calls block() and unblock(). block() registers the scroll lock when fullScreen and sets the z-index after nextTick when autoZIndex, the z-index key is the string literal "modal"; unblock() clears the z-index while the mask is still rendered and clearZIndex is not gated by autoZIndex. unmount while blocked emits no unblocked. The root has aria-busy bound to blocked; the mask has no role or aria-hidden. The fullScreen mask is positioned fixed by the document rule; the stylesheet gives the mask position fixed, then absolute in a later rule, then fixed again only for the document variant. block-ui-style.ts is an untyped style module. This family has no @ultimate/uix-styles entry and keeps its css locally.
